title: HERMES Thermodynamic Metrics
description: Operational indicators measuring the energetic cost of maintaining useful order, not merely task speed. Cross-references canon: docs/HERMES_EXECUTION_DISCIPLINE_AND_CONTEXT_GOVERNOR.md (Thermodynamic observability).

compute_energy.description: CPU, GPU, accelerator time, and energy per accepted result.

context_churn.description: Context repeatedly loaded, summarized, discarded, or retrieved without contributing to accepted output.

coordination_friction.description: Resources spent routing, reconciling, waiting on, or correcting agents.

semantic_drift.description: Deviation from the approved objective and constraints.

memory_entropy.description: Duplication, contradiction, staleness, and unresolved conflicts in memory.

compression_loss.description: Decision-relevant information lost during context compaction.

tool_failure_heat.description: Resource expenditure on failed calls and retries.

useful_work_ratio.description: Verified accepted value divided by total resource expenditure.

state.description: Health state of the measurement; absent measurements must be labeled UNKNOWN, never assumed.

provenance.description: Source reference for the measurement, or null when unknown.
